title: Volatile/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Cephalon Cy: "Overheat that thing's reactors. I will update you on the fly."
- Cephalon Cy: "A two-part approach. Part one: get inside. Part two: something else."
- Cephalon Cy: "Target the reactor. Get in. Lower defenses. Get out. Then we make with the artillery."
- Cephalon Cy: "A nearby Corpus officer carries credentials that would make this job easier. Just saying."
- Cephalon Cy: "Tagging nearby Corpus officer. Their credentials would assist with the reactor job. Your call."
- Cephalon Cy: "High-level VIP credentials nearby. Stealing them would simplify the reactor plan."
- Cephalon Cy: "Credential authenticity confirmed. We can go."
- Cephalon Cy: "Adjust the reactor signature. Render it vulnerable to our weapons. Go."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor invulnerable to our artillery. Recalibrate reactor to render it vulnerable."
- Cephalon Cy: "Objective: destroy vessel. Complication: Reactor invulnerable to Railjack artillery. Solution: recalibrate reactor."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor console nearby. The codes you obtained will grant unimpeded access. Corpus Engineers will not immediately detect intrusion."
- Cephalon Cy: "Use the security codes you garnered to access the marked reactor console. Corpus Engineers will detect nothing amiss at first."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor console on scope. You will need to gain access without security codes. The hard way. Corpus Engineers will attempt to make it harder."
- Cephalon Cy: "Breach reactor security. No quick access codes available. Corpus Engineers are on standby. This will get messy."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor heating up. Keep heat levels within specified parameters."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor cooking. Keep heat levels within assigned margins."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor heat spiking. Reactor heat must maintain specified range."
- Cephalon Cy: "Maintain reactor heat within optimal range. Target vents when needed to discharge excess heat."
- Cephalon Cy: "Target vents when necessary to balance thermal load."
- Cephalon Cy: "Heat levels climbing. Force vents open to cool reactor when needed."
- Cephalon Cy: "Vent shaft open. Reactor heat dropping."
- Cephalon Cy: "Vent destroyed. Pressure dropping. Core heat dropping."

path: Venting and Heat is Within Threshold
lines: - Cephalon Cy: "Reactor heat at optimal levels. Maintain."
- Cephalon Cy: "Core heat optimized. Keep it stable."

path: Venting and Heat is Below Threshold
lines: - Cephalon Cy: "Heat vented. Levels dropping below optimal level."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor cooled. Below optimal. Let it warm up."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor temp is below usable levels. Heat must reaccumulate."
- Cephalon Cy: "High heat. Calibration compromised. Vent."
- Cephalon Cy: "Core heat excessive. Target vents."
- Cephalon Cy: "Warning. Reactor is in meltdown. Reduce heat. Now."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sabotage attempt averted. Engineers will regroup."
- Cephalon Cy: "Engineer has failed to shut down reactor. Good."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor shutdown sequence has been initiated. Breach the console while there is still time."
- Cephalon Cy: "Corpus have initiated reactor shutdown."
- Cephalon Cy: "Partial reactor recalibration complete. Identifying new target heat range."
- Cephalon Cy: "Heat range potential exhausted. Recalibrating. Setting new thermal target."
- Cephalon Cy: "Recalibration proceeding. Shifting target waveband. Adjust reactor heat accordingly."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have what we came for. Corpus jammers are overriding Railjack recall. Return via Archwing."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor recalibration complete. Hm. Recall is being jammed. You will have to Archwing."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor recalibration complete. Return to this Railjack via Archwing."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor marked. Isolating optimal firing vector. Pilot, line us up. Forward artillery, take them out."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reactor identified. Pilot: Align Railjack with target vector. Gunners: Ready forward artillery."
- Cephalon Cy: "Subreactors on scope. Forward artillery, hit those targets."
- Cephalon Cy: "I have visuals on multiple reactors. Engage forward artillery. Blast them."
- Cephalon Cy: "Mission complete. Capital Ship decapitated."
- Cephalon Cy: "Mission complete. Obelisk is a tombstone."
- Cephalon Cy: "Corpus Pillar toppled. Mission complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "Patching comms through Entrati tactical adviser. Come home safe."
- Cephalon Cy: "Incoming transmission from Deimos. Crew, make me proud."
